description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and vocabulary size for four different languages. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Iterations” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks every 100 units. The y-axis is labeled “Vocabulary Size” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5000, with tick marks every 1000 units.  

The blue line represents the “Spanish” language, and it is a solid line that begins at approximately 0 at an x-value of 0 and increases to approximately 3100 at an x-value of 500.  The orange line represents the “Korean” language, and it is a solid line that begins at approximately 0 at an x-value of 0 and increases to approximately 2700 at an x-value of 500. The green line represents the “Japanese” language, and it is a solid line that begins at approximately 0 at an x-value of 0 and increases to approximately 2800 at an x-value of 500.  Additionally, there are multiple translucent lines clustered around each solid line, representing individual runs for each language, hovering closely around each respective solid line throughout the plot’s range. A diagonal gray line is present, beginning at 0 for both axes, and increasing linearly to 5000 on the y-axis at an x-value of 500.
